tools.name: diagnostics_get
tools.title: Get diagnostics
tools.description: Return server and slicer diagnostics: OrcaSlicer version and build, server version, backend mode ('headless' CLI-backed or 'interactive' embedded in a running app), active session state (project open? last slice status?), and optionally the tail of the slicer log. Use when a tool fails unexpectedly or to check capabilities before starting.

log_lines.description: How many trailing log lines to include. 0 (default) omits the log.
